stanzas:
Forgive me, Mom, for growing up too soon,
For the pain I caused—wound upon wound,
Forgive me, Mom, I'm guilty in so many ways,
Forgive me for not becoming like my older brother,
My life, Mom, is like a black-and-white movie,
Everything seems okay, but there's always a "but",
It's not easy to understand why everything is exactly this way,
Exactly this way and no other. What does it mean?

Wish me luck, Mom!
The road is calling me, you hide your tears,
Mom, I won't be gone long,
I know—you know, Mom, I know you believe, Mom,
You believed in me and you still do,
And that's a lot—and when fate knocked me off my feet,
Through pain and despair I heard a voice: "Get up, son!"
I dedicate this ballad to all mothers
Who give us their love,

Tell me, Mom, how much is my life worth,
My life is a drama, my soul soars upward,
Tell me, Mom, how much is my life worth,
My life is a drama, my soul soars upward,

In the hardest minutes of my life,
When death came very close,
Stars fell from the sky in sparks, and thoughts of you,
Mom, like a ray of light,
Searching for an answer, searching for a path,
I gather all my strength and keep walking,
Forgive me for everything, Mom, I was guilty in so many ways,
But it all stayed in the past—time can't be turned back,
I try to rise from my knees, lift myself a little,
But something keeps me from breaking away from the ground,
I pray. God, give me strength to understand
What troubles me, who will help me,
Maybe, God, my faith is weak,
But wherever I am I remember these words,
Forgive me for rarely saying them to you,
"Mom, I love you!"

Tell me, Mom, how much is my life worth,
My life is a drama, my soul soars upward,

Whom we cherish,

analysis.translation:
Forgive me, Mom, for growing up too soon,
For the pain I caused—wound upon wound,
Forgive me, Mom, I'm guilty in so many ways,

analysis.text: Открытие — исповедь сыну, который вырос слишком рано и причинял боль за болью. «Чёрно-белое кино» и вечное «но» задают тон: жизнь будто почти устроилась, но изъян не исчезает. Вопрос «что это значит» — не философия, а детская растерянность перед чужим сценарием.

analysis.text: Дорога зовёт, мать прячет слёзы, сын утешает, что недолго. Вера матери становится его опорой; даже когда судьба валит с ног, он слышит её голос «вставай, сынок». Баллада объявлена посвящением всем матерям — личная исповедь сразу расширяется.

analysis.translation:
In the hardest minutes of my life,
When death came very close,
Stars fell from the sky in sparks, and thoughts of you,
Mom, like a ray of light,
Searching for an answer, searching for a path,
I gather all my strength and keep walking,
Forgive me for everything, Mom, I was guilty in so many ways,
But it all stayed in the past—time can't be turned back,
I try to rise from my knees, lift myself a little,
But something keeps me from breaking away from the ground,
I pray. God, give me strength to understand
What troubles me, who will help me,
Maybe, God, my faith is weak,
But wherever I am I remember these words,
Forgive me for rarely saying them to you,
"Mom, I love you!"
analysis.text: Кульминация близости к смерти и образ матери как луча среди падающих звёзд. Прошлое прощено, но встать с колен мешает что-то невысказанное; молитва просит не подвига, а понимания. Редкие слова «мама, я тебя люблю» наконец произнесены вслух.
